1.consolidated_definition: art. espec. Artista. Artista de espéctaculos o variedades, que canta, baila o actúa. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Véase performer, performeador. Sylvia Villafañe, organizadora del evento y directora de la Galería Petrus, junto a Rosy Ward del Caribe Hilton, indica que, de sus artistas, Carlos Dávila Rinaldi, Nini de la Torre, Gamaliel Rodríguez y Víctor Rodríguez Gotay participarán como performeros del arte esta noche (El Nuevo Día, 09-09-03)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Artist (esp.). A performer or variety artist who sings, dances, or acts. Anglicism adapted, relatively uncommon. See performer, performer.

Note: 
- "Artista de espéctaculos" translates to "performer of spectacles"
- "variedades" translates to "variety"
- "Galería Petrus" is a cultural reference preserved in the translation
- "Caribe Hilton" is also a cultural reference preserved in the translation
